rules.half: 100% above a rising 30-week mean, 50% after a weekly close below it

methods.lump: all capital on the entry month's first trading day
methods.staged12: capital split into 12 equal monthly tranches; waiting money earns the T-bill rate
methods.monthly: one equal contribution on the first trading day of every month of the horizon

entries: first trading day of every month from 2000-01
execution: weekly-close signal, trade at next close, 10bp per side; cash earns 13-week T-bill (^IRX)

metrics.lump/staged12: annualized return on the full capital, max drawdown of account value, share losing money
metrics.monthly: money-weighted annual return (XIRR), final value / contributions, worst floating loss vs money put in

note: staged and monthly results are sums of per-tranche sub-accounts that each follow the rule
